assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management.
CPT 93229 is the service under appeal.
Diagnosis code I48.0 is used to support medical necessity.
Diagnosis code R00.2 is used to support medical necessity.
The claim is denied under reason code PR-204.
